src/player/sonic_player.cpp.reason: Body dispatches through address-bearing external calls and reaches guest-defined ground acceleration. Requires semantic Sonic actions plus shared player owners; preserve partial failures and ordering.
ownership_notes: SonicPlayerGlobals owns forced/stage/model/sound/task values; forced_at_3b29d08 explicitly borrows GameResetState. actor_current::State is composed rather than a second actor owner. Review full alias graph before migration.

src/player/sonic_animation_operations.hp.reason: SonicAnimationOperation stores instruction PCs and numeric field offsets in 1027 constexpr recipes; exemption from a lexical counter does not establish typed game initialization.
ownership_notes: Generated immutable recipe table is code/diagnostic structure, not independent runtime state. Interpreter is sonic_animation_table.cpp; resource/content ownership remains in the imported animation owner.

src/player/sonic_animation_table.cpp.reason: Initializer interprets instruction recipes, fixture-availability optionals and source PC failures. Preserve interleaved reads/stores through reference diagnostics; native initialization must express named data.
ownership_notes: PlayerAnimationTable records are mutated in source operation order; SonicAnimationExport resource references are borrowed from source. Adapter must preserve partial publication and per-reached-read missingness.

src/player/player_scene_decode.cpp.reason: Image parses MZ/PE32 and maps executable virtual addresses in player code. Decoding belongs at importer/reference boundary, with typed collision resources consumed by player.
ownership_notes: Private Image maps borrowed executable bytes; DecodedSceneLandTable publishes resource/location maps. Move parser boundary with its callers and retain resource alias identity.

src/game/game_reset.cpp.reason: Reset policy dispatches by numeric source/callee address and mutates address-named owner fields. Rewrite shared reset behavior, retaining order and partial state.
ownership_notes: GameResetState owns word_at_3b29d08 and two heap identities; word_at_3abdf80 borrows GameLoopState and RNG is CrtRandState&. SonicPlayerGlobals borrows the forced-reset word; migrate both consumers together.

src/guest/game_logic.cpp.reason: Recovered press accumulation, pending tick loop and frame policy coexist with missing-fixture facts and dispatch. These algorithms must be shared engine/input behavior, not exempt reference plumbing.
ownership_notes: GameLogicRuntime borrows GameLogicState and four controller owners; timing is shared with frame control. Controller pointers and pressed bits are read lazily and after callbacks. Do not snapshot into a new independent owner.

src/guest/ninja_queue_lifecycle.cpp.reason: Recovered queue reset/allocation, color/depth/render state and owner stores live under guest. Split shared queue lifecycle from original buffer identity and diagnostic marshalling.
ownership_notes: NinjaQueueLifecycleOwners borrows arena/queue runtime, consumer, projection, timing and table words (see engine/ninja_queue_lifecycle.hpp). Arena rebind invalidates record identity; preserve before initialization stores.

src/engine/ninja_queue_consumer.cpp.reason: Consumer mixes render policy, record offsets, fixture facts and failure PCs. Preserve live NEXT reads after callbacks, lazy validation and explicit unrecovered draws.
ownership_notes: NinjaQueueConsumerRuntime borrows queue/runtime/sprite/projection and consumer counters. Consumer must see callback mutation and NEXT after callbacks. Full canonical map remains open.

src/runtime/native_session.hpp.reason: Session owns save, menu/resource, sound/listener and flow fields together with attachment API. Some source owners use comments rather than GLOBAL annotations; whole-owner and alias audit remains open, no duplicate-owner verdict.
ownership_notes: Session owns flow_, soft_reset_, save fields, task handles, sound_, sound_effects_, PCM/media and resource lifetimes. Borrowers include native session/UI callbacks; static include links are candidates only. Resolve each source-global owner and all attachment/callback users before splitting.
